threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'bacon sarnie' means meat, not just a grease-soaked bun with a hint of bacon, don’t you?
Caught a night bus home last week, and a group was singing old reggae tracks. Felt like we were on a moving dance floor. Just Brixton magic.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: One evening, I saw an old man feeding the pigeons while a saxophonist played jazz nearby, and for a moment, it felt like the heart of a city wrapped in warmth.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a Döner shop that opens at 2 AM, with a line of clubbers just craving late-night curry sauce and fresh bread.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they avoid eye contact with the street performers but still know the best taco stand at 2 AM.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy on the 49 bus juggling oranges while the driver swatted at a pigeon. Classic Tenderloin chaos—only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are all about sipping sangria, but locals know they're really for old men playing cards and kids riding their bikes.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell the newcomers by their bewildered expressions at the Meridiana crossings; locals just glide through like it's a dance.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's acceptable to wait for a bus without checking your phone every five seconds like you might miss your life’s calling.
Saw a guy on the 59 last night serenading the driver with old school reggae; everyone was either laughing or pretending not to listen.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The old lady at the bakery yelling at the pigeons to get lost while handing me a warm Brötchen felt oddly like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know it's a true Berlin moment when the U-Bahn station has a live DJ spinning tracks at 2 AM, while buses just sit empty due to the latest strike.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone's from here when they know to avoid the BART exit at Civic Center after 5 PM. Smoke and sirens are just part of the evening commute.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 rider who serenaded the whole bus with an off-key but heartfelt rendition of 'I Will Survive'—Muni's own karaoke night.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can find quiet spots in Gràcia during fiesta de Gràcia. The locals have the same idea, and it gets packed with energy and noise.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they grip the metro handrails like they’re bracing for turbulence, pretending it's not crowded.
